1: // Minimal implementation of "Cosmic Cleaner" game
2: // Canvas id: "game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
8:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
9: 
10:   // Ship configuration
11:   const ship = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, w: 30, h: 40, speed: 4, cargo: 0, alive: true };
12:   let vacuumOn = false;
13:   const keys = {};
14: 
15:   // Simple asteroid/debris generator
16:   const objects = [];
17:   function spawn() {
18:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
19:     const isDebris = Math.random() < 0.4; // 40% are collectable debris
20:     objects.push({
21:       x: Math.random() * (W - size),
22:       y: -size,
23:       w: size,
24:       h: size,
25:       speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2,
26:       debris: isDebris,
27:     });
28:   }
29:   setInterval(spawn, 800);
30: 
31:   // Input handling
32:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
33:     keys[e.key] = true;
34:     if (e.key === ' ') vacuumOn = true;
35:     if (e.key === 'd') ship.cargo = 0; // cargo‑dump mini‑game shortcut
36:   });
37:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
38:     keys[e.key] = false;
39:     if (e.key === ' ') vacuumOn = false;
40:   });
41: 
42:   // Collision helpers
43:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
44:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
45:   }
46: 
47:   // Main loop
48:   function update() {
49:     if (!ship.alive) return; // stop updating after death
50:     // Move ship
51:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
52:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
53:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
54:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
55:     // Keep within bounds
56:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - ship.w, ship.x));
57:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - ship.h, ship.y));
58: 
59:     // Update objects
60:     for (let i = objects.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
61:       const o = objects[i];
62:       o.y += o.speed;
63:       // Collision with ship
64:       if (rectIntersect(ship, o)) {
65:         if (o.debris && vacuumOn) {
66:           ship.cargo++;
67:           objects.splice(i, 1);
68:           continue;
69:         } else if (!o.debris) {
70:           // asteroid hit – ship destroyed
71:           ship.alive = false;
72:           break;
73:         }
74:       }
75:       // Remove off‑screen objects
76:       if (o.y > H) objects.splice(i, 1);
77:     }
78:     // Overload check
79:     if (ship.cargo > 10) ship.alive = false;
80:   }
81: 
82:   function draw() {
83:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
84:     // Draw ship
85:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.alive ? '#0ff' : '#f00';
86:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
87:     // Vacuum beam visual
88:     if (vacuumOn) {
89:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
90:       ctx.lineWidth = 3;
91:       ctx.beginPath();
92:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
93:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, 0);
94:       ctx.stroke();
95:     }
96:     // Draw objects
97:     objects.forEach(o => {
98:       ctx.fillStyle = o.debris ? '#ff0' : '#888';
99:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
100:     });
101:     // HUD
102:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
103:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
104:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + ship.cargo, 10, 20);
105:     if (!ship.alive) ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2 - 50, H / 2);
106:   }
107: 
108:   function loop() {
109:     update();
110:     draw();
111:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
112:   }
113:   loop();
114: })();
